history.body: Hi, I work around Perai and saw your Seberang Jaya ad. Is this location convenient for daily travel?

Pearl Residences is in established Seberang Jaya, with connectivity toward the Butterworth and wider mainland road network, so it’s a sensible area to consider if you work around Perai. Exact commute time depends on your workplace and route—what part of Perai do you usually travel to?
Mostly around Perai for work, and I’d like shops and food nearby too. Is Seberang Jaya already quite established?

Yes—Seberang Jaya is an established urban area, rather than one relying entirely on future development. Project materials describe connections toward Sunway Carnival Mall, Chai Leng Park and the wider Butterworth/mainland network. I can’t confirm exact distances or drive times to shops and eateries, but the established setting is relevant to the convenience you’re looking for. A viewing could help you judge it for your Perai commute and daily routine—would you like to arrange one?
